Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a fixed bonus when the leftover after placement lies between 10 and 30, so bins landing in that band outrank slightly tighter bins outside it. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover falls outside the band while another falls inside. It may help by reserving a usable mid-size residual, or fail if the band is the wrong width for the item mix.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (50 if r - item >= 10 and r - item <= 30 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
